[[Captain]] '''Finsas''' is an officer from [[Arad Doman]] under the command of [[Rodel Ituralde]].

== Activities ==
He is part of the Domani army that is sent by the [[Dragon]] to [[Maradon]]. Finsas' troop is attacked by a group of [[Shadowspawn]], who are also using trebuchets. He is injured in the encounter.

==Trivia==
*Finsas is named after Kine Lohne Finsas, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
